summary: NatWest Group plc furnished a Form 6-K reporting initial notifications of transactions by Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities under Article 19 of the UK Market Abuse Regulation. On 1 October 2026, Chairman Rick Haythornthwaite and nine independent non-executive directors purchased ordinary shares (ISIN GB00BM8PJY71) on the London Stock Exchange at 6.7040 per share, under the company's chairman and non-executive director shareholding policy. Purchases were small, ranging from 182 to 1,835 shares. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors were disclosed; this is a routine PDMR shareholding notification, not a special situation.
